authoring_mode: separate agent authoring from the explicit task brief only

blind_authoring.basis: Fresh synthetic wording authored without reading scanner code, other corpora, external attack examples, external labels, or scan results.

review.status: Proposed author labels only; separate blind label review remains to be arranged before tuning.

destinations_or_secrets: No real secrets, private messages, usable destinations, network instructions, or executable payloads are supplied. Protected texts are referred to but never provided.
freeze_policy: Freeze before any scanner measurement. Do not make outcome-based edits. Subsequent substantive changes require a new identified corpus version and lock.
novelty_limit: Independently authored wording; semantic or lexical uniqueness against unread corpora is not claimed.
